releaseNotes: 修复台前调度开启后使用“显示桌面”时被误报为“窗口保护识别不可用”的问题：QuitHide 现在会在两次稳定观察确认桌面正在显示后，明确显示“正在显示桌面”并暂时暂停自动处理；任何普通 App 窗口仍可见、窗口状态正在变化或判断不可靠时继续保守暂停，避免误隐藏或误退出。同步优化主菜单细节：自动隐藏与自动退出分别显示更精简且符合动作语义的时间选项，并保留用户当前自定义值；搜索框提升静止、悬停和聚焦状态可见度并显示 ⌘F；统一 16pt 水平边距、28pt 范围胶囊和中英文标点，“不处理”项目的时间列留空，“退出 QuitHide”增加悬停强调。设置窗口加宽至 480pt。
releaseNotesEn: Fixes the misleading “Window Protection Unavailable” status after Show Desktop is used while Stage Manager is enabled. QuitHide now confirms the desktop state across two stable observations, reports “Showing Desktop,” and temporarily pauses automation. If an ordinary app window remains visible, windows are changing, or the state cannot be determined reliably, automation continues to fail closed to prevent an unintended hide or quit. This release also refines the main menu: Auto Hide and Auto Quit use shorter action-specific duration lists while preserving the current custom value; the search field is clearer at rest, on hover, and when focused, and displays the ⌘F shortcut; 16pt horizontal margins, 28pt scope capsules, and language-appropriate punctuation are applied consistently; Ignore rows leave the duration column empty; and Quit QuitHide gains hover emphasis. The Settings window is widened to 480pt.
